news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ:NKTR) Just Reported And Analysts Have Been Lifting Their Price Targets
news.summary: Following the August 13 Q2 report, several sell-side analysts (including Citi, Canaccord Genuity and Piper Sandler) reiterated Buy ratings and raised price targets on NKTR, with the consensus 12-month target now around $150-153. The bullish revisions cite the strengthened cash runway into Q3 2028 and reaffirmed Phase 3 timelines for rezpegaldesleukin, even as the stock itself has drifted lower since the print.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NASDAQ: NKTR) insider plans 418-share sale
news.summary: An SEC Form 4/144 filing disclosed a planned open-market sale of just 418 Nektar shares by a company insider, a modest transaction consistent with the routine, sales-only pattern of insider activity seen since the stock's rally. The size is too small to be a directional signal on its own but adds to the broader trend of no insider buying in recent months.

news.headline: Nektar (NASDAQ: NKTR) exec to sell 186 shares, partly for taxes
news.summary: A Nektar executive disclosed plans to sell 186 shares, with the filing noting the sale is partly to cover tax withholding on vested equity rather than a discretionary bet against the stock. Like the adjacent 418-share filing, it is a small, routine transaction rather than a material insider signal.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) Stock Slides As Cash Burn Clouds Pipeline Progress
news.summary: Despite raised year-end cash guidance of $815-840 million, quarterly revenue fell 9.4% year over year to $10.13 million and the trailing 12-month net loss widened 28.5% to $157.13 million, leaving investors focused on the burn rate even as ZENITH AD-3 tracks toward a late-September 2026 start. Institutional ownership has fallen sharply quarter over quarter and insider activity has been sales-only in recent months.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026, up sharply from $245.8 million at year-end 2025, giving runway into Q3 2028, past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss narrowed to $40.6 million ($1.23/share) from $41.6 million ($2.95/share) a year earlier, and the company reaffirmed plans to start a single registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study in early 2027.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar started ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, with a third study (ZENITH AD-3) in treatment-experienced patients due to follow. The program was designed after FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targets initial topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor experience, is guided to begin by late September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 study in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept data. This adds a second, funded value driver alongside atopic dermatitis.

catalysts.label: Additional REZOLVE-AD / REZOLVE-AA data at medical conferences
catalysts.detail: Nektar has signalled further presentations of longer-term Phase 2b atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata data, including off-treatment durability after discontinuation in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Durability of the Treg effect off drug remains a key swing factor ahead of the AA Phase 3 start.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Nektar's next quarterly report should update cash burn against the raised year-end guidance of $815-840 million, ZENITH AD-3 enrollment status, and preparations for the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3 start. Exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission. Cash runway now extends into Q3 2028, covering this readout.

pulse: Nektar's Q2 2026 report on August 13 confirmed the balance-sheet story: cash and investments of $1.02 billion (runway into Q3 2028) comfortably fund the ZENITH AD Phase 3 program through its mid-2028 readout, and management reaffirmed both the ZENITH AD-3 start (late September 2026) and a new registrational alopecia areata study for early 2027. Despite an EPS beat, shares have drifted since the print as investors focus on rising R&D burn (net loss widened, R&D guidance raised to $210-230 million), falling institutional ownership, and sales-only insider activity (several small routine Form 4 filings in mid-August), with the stock trading in the mid-$70s in mid-August versus a 52-week high near $109. Sell-side sentiment stays firmly bullish (Citi at Buy/$151, Canaccord and Piper Sandler both reiterating Buy in mid-August; consensus target near $153 against a Strong Buy-leaning analyst base) - watch ZENITH AD-3 enrollment progress and any interim REZOLVE-AD/AA durability data in H2 as near-term sentiment drivers into 2027.
